headline: Workday to Announce Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Financial Results on August 27, 2026
summary: Workday, Inc. (NASDAQ: WDAY), the enterprise AI platform for HR, finance, and IT, will announce its fiscal 2027 second quarter financial results after market close on Thursday, August 27, 2026. The company will host a conference call at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time / 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time to review its financial results and business outlook.
